```python
def split_commas(s):
    out=[]; cur=[]; depth=0; i=0; n=len(s)
    while i<n:
        c=s[i]
        if c=='"' and depth==0:
            # consume quoted string
            j=skip_quoted(s,i,n)  # may raise
            cur.append(s[i:j]); i=j; continue
        if c=='<': depth+=1; cur.append(c); i+=1; continue
        if c=='>': 
            if depth>0: depth-=1
            cur.append(c); i+=1; continue
        if c==',' and depth==0:
            out.append(''.join(cur)); cur=[]; i+=1; continue
        cur.append(c); i+=1
    out.append(''.join(cur))
    return out
```
